trail.name: Hurricane Pass via South Jenny Lake
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Jenny Lake Trailhead marker; 8.4 m from reviewed route/access geometry. This is an area forecast reference, not navigation or uniform conditions along the route.
trail.planningNote: This profile includes walking from South Jenny Lake and returning on foot; it does not use the shorter shuttle-boat distance. Long, steep mountain hike: check current conditions with a backcountry ranger. Snow travel may require specialist skills and equipment. The trailhead-area forecast does not represent the higher route. TrailPack covers day-hike packing, not climbing or overnight equipment.

accessRoute.returnPlan: Walk back to the same trailhead; no boat needed.
accessRoute.distanceScope: Full walking trip, including the return.
